hero.title: Let's paddle together
hero.lead: Kayak trips and river expeditions. We handle the route, gear and safety — you just paddle and enjoy the view.

tours.title: Tours
tours.subtitle: We'll match a trip to your experience: from a calm day on the water to several days on the route.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Send us your dates, group size and experience. We'll suggest a fitting route.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: We send a packing list and a briefing on what to bring and wear.

steps.title: Safety briefing
steps.text: Before the start we cover seating, paddling and water safety rules.

steps.title: On the route
steps.text: We go with an experienced guide, with stops to rest and take photos.

included.title: What's included
items: First-aid kit and communication on the route

bring.title: What to bring
items: A change of clothes in a waterproof bag
Shoes you don't mind getting wet
